en.name: Glute Set
en.detail: lay on back with legs strait out. push down into the surface with each leg one at a time. Hold for 3 seconds then release. you should feel the glutes contracting.

en.name: Bridges
en.detail: laying on back, bring feet up flat on the surface by bending the knees. Push down through your feet and raise your hips up toward the cieling to form the bridge. Hold for 3 seconds, and then lower slowly back to the table. You should feel a squeeze in the glutes at the top of the bridge.

en.name: Seat Taps
en.detail: Stand facing away from the end of an about upper thigh high surface (ie... arm rest of couch) slowly lower your seat back until you touch the object working on hinging at the hips to "sit back." as soon as your seat touches to the surfaces, come back up without shifting weight into the surface. This should feel like a mini "squat" but not full depth.

en.name: Air Squats
en.detail: Perform a squat to full available depth trying to stay slow and controlled

en.name: Tandem Stance Balance
en.detail: Stand with one foot in front of the other and try and balance for 30 seconds with as little hand use as possible.

en.name: Narrow Stance Balance
en.detail: Stand with feet together and try and balance for 30 seconds at a time with as little hand use as possible for balance.

en.name: Single Leg Stance Balance
en.detail: Stand on one leg for 30 seconds with as little hand support as possible.
en.dose: 3 sets of 30 seconds on each leg.

en.name: Standing Hip ABDuction
en.detail: stand on one leg while holding nuetral posture. Move non-stance leg out to the side and back slowly and under control. You should feel contraction on the outside of the hip.

en.name: Heel to Toe Walks
en.detail: Walk one foot in front of the other, touching the heel of each step to the toe of the previous step. walk alongside a countertop using hands as needed for balance but as little as possible.

en.name: Task Oriented Tandem Stance
en.detail: While performing daily duties (dishes, laundry, etc...) stand with one foot in front of the other, practicing keeping balance while reaching for objects related to the activity. Also can be done playing board games, card games, etc...

en.name: Eyes closed stance
en.detail: standing normally at a countertop or other solid surface, try to stand with eyes closed without losing balance using hands for support only as needed.

en.name: Narrow Stance Eyes Closed
en.detail: Stand at counter or other firm surface with a narrow stance. Try to hold balance with eyes closed for 30 seconds at a time, using hands for support only as necessary.

en.name: Single Leg Stance Eyes Closed
en.detail: Stand at counter or other firm surface with a single leg stance. Try to hold balance with eyes closed for 30 seconds at a time, using hands for support only as necessary.

en.name: Unsupported Sitting with Eyes closed
en.detail: Sit at the edge of a chair with feet flat on floor and sitting on a fluffy pillow. Close your eyes and try to maintain upright posture for 30 seconds at a time only using arms for support as necessary.

en.name: Task Oriented Single Leg Stance
en.detail: While performing daily duties (dishes, laundry, etc...) stand on one leg practicing keeping balance while reaching for objects related to the activity. Also can be done playing board games, card games, etc. do for 30 seconds at a time for the duration of the activity as tolerated.

en.name: 90/90 Hip Mobility
en.detail: Sit in 90/90 position, both knees at 90°. Shift weight toward back hip, sit tall.

en.name: Abdominal Brace
en.detail: Lying on back. Gently brace core as if about to be poked, breathe normally.

en.name: Ankle Alphabet
en.detail: Seated, foot off floor. Trace the alphabet with your big toe in both directions.

en.name: Anterior Shoulder Stretch
en.detail: Stand in doorway or beside wall. Place arm behind body with palm flat against surface. Gently rotate torso forward until stretch felt along front of shoulder and chest.

en.name: Banded Ankle Distraction
en.detail: Band around ankle from behind. Drive knee forward into dorsiflexion through full range.

en.name: Banded Shoulder Elevation
en.detail: Stand on band, handles at sides. Shrug shoulders up toward ears against band resistance. Pause at top and slowly lower.

en.name: Bar Hang Scapular Depression
en.detail: Hang from bar with arms straight. Without bending elbows, actively depress shoulder blades to slightly elevate body. Hold, then relax back to passive hang.

en.name: Bear Crawl Hold
en.detail: On hands and knees, lift knees 2 inches off floor. Brace core and hold.

en.name: Bicep Stretch
en.detail: Stand facing wall, place palm flat against wall at shoulder height with thumb up. Gently rotate body away until stretch felt along front of arm. Hold.

en.name: Book Openings
en.detail: Side-lying, knees bent. Rotate top arm to opposite side following with eyes, return.

en.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
en.detail: Rear foot elevated on bench behind you. Lower front knee toward floor then return.

en.name: Cervical AROM
en.detail: Seated upright. Move slowly through flexion, extension, rotation, and side bending.

en.name: Cervical CARS
en.detail: Seated upright. Perform slow controlled articular rotation of cervical spine through full range.

en.name: Cervical Extension Stretch
en.detail: Seated tall, gently tilt head back looking toward ceiling. Move only through a comfortable range. Feel stretch along front of neck. Return slowly.

en.name: Cervical Flexion Stretch
en.detail: Seated or standing, gently drop chin toward chest. Place hand on back of head for light overpressure if tolerated. Feel stretch along back of neck.

en.name: Cervical Rotation with Band
en.detail: Attach light band to a stable point at head height. Secure other end to forehead with pad. Slowly rotate head away from anchor against resistance. Return with control.

en.name: Cervical Rotation Stretch
en.detail: Seated upright. Slowly rotate head to look over one shoulder through comfortable range. Hold at end range. Return through center and repeat other side.

en.name: Cervical Rotation with Retraction
en.detail: Seated upright, chin tucked slightly. Rotate head fully to one side maintaining retraction throughout. Return through center and repeat other side. Control each repetition.

en.name: Chin Tuck
en.detail: Sitting tall. Draw chin straight back (retraction) without tilting head, hold briefly.

en.name: Clamshell
en.detail: Side-lying, knees bent. Keep feet stacked and rotate top knee toward ceiling.

en.name: Copenhagen Plank
en.detail: Side plank with top foot on bench. Hold body straight without hip drop.

en.name: Cross-Body Stretch
en.detail: Pull one arm across chest with opposite hand. Feel stretch in back of shoulder.

en.name: Cross-Body Tricep Stretch
en.detail: Reach arm across body at shoulder height, keeping elbow slightly bent. Use other hand to pull elbow across and gently flex it further. Feel stretch in tricep.

en.name: Dead Bug
en.detail: Lying on back, arms and knees at 90°. Lower opposite arm and leg without arching back.

en.name: PNF D2 Flexion Pattern
en.detail: Start with arm across body in extension and internal rotation. Sweep arm upward and outward ending overhead in external rotation. Reverse for return. Use band for resistance.

en.name: Doorway Bicep Stretch
en.detail: Place palm on doorframe behind you at hip height, thumb pointing up. Keeping arm straight, rotate body forward until stretch felt through bicep and forearm. Hold.

en.name: Doorway Pec Stretch
en.detail: Stand in doorway, arm at 90°. Gently step forward until stretch felt across chest.

en.name: Eccentric Heel Drop
en.detail: Stand on step edge, rise on both feet, then lower slowly on one foot through full range.

en.name: External Rotation with Band
en.detail: Elbow at side, forearm parallel to floor. Rotate forearm outward against band resistance.

en.name: Foam Roll Segmental Mob
en.detail: Foam roller under mid-back. Shift slowly to each thoracic level, pausing 2–3 seconds.

en.name: Foam Roller Extension
en.detail: Place foam roller perpendicular under mid-back. Allow gentle extension over the roller.

en.name: Full-Can Exercise
en.detail: Stand on band, arm at 30° forward of body plane (scapular plane). Raise arm to shoulder height with thumb pointing up (full can position). Lower slowly.

en.name: Glute Bridge
en.detail: Lying on back, feet flat. Drive hips up to form a straight line, squeeze glutes at top.

en.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor
en.detail: One knee on pad, opposite foot forward. Shift weight forward until stretch felt in front hip.

en.name: Hammer Curl
en.detail: Stand on band, thumb pointing up (neutral grip). Curl forearm to shoulder without rotating wrist. Targets brachialis and brachioradialis. Lower fully between reps.

en.name: Knee-to-Wall Ankle Mobilization
en.detail: Stand facing wall, foot 5 cm from base. Drive knee to touch wall keeping heel down. Progress distance.

en.name: Standing Ankle Dorsiflexion AROM
en.detail: Standing at wall, hands on wall. Rock forward driving knee toward wall. Keep heel down.

en.name: Seated Ankle Dorsiflexion AROM
en.detail: Seated, foot off floor. Pull foot upward toward shin through full dorsiflexion range. Return.

en.name: Ankle Eversion CARs
en.detail: Seated or standing. Move foot through eversion combined with dorsiflexion in controlled arc.

en.name: Standing Ankle Eversion
en.detail: Stand with support. Lift inner edge of foot turning sole outward. Hold briefly and return.

en.name: Seated Ankle Eversion AROM
en.detail: Seated, foot off floor. Rotate sole outward through full eversion range. Control return.

en.name: Ankle Inversion CARs
en.detail: Seated or standing. Move foot through inversion combined with plantarflexion in controlled arc.

en.name: Standing Ankle Inversion
en.detail: Stand with support. Lift outer edge of foot turning sole inward. Hold briefly and return.

en.name: Seated Ankle Inversion AROM
en.detail: Seated, foot off floor. Rotate sole inward through full inversion range. Control return.

en.name: Ankle Plantarflexion CARs
en.detail: Seated or standing. Move foot through maximum plantarflexion arc including slight inversion and eversion.

en.name: Standing Calf Raise AROM
en.detail: Stand at edge of step. Rise onto toes through maximum plantarflexion. Lower slowly.

en.name: Seated Ankle Plantarflexion AROM
en.detail: Seated, foot off floor. Point foot downward through full plantarflexion range. Return.

en.name: Progressive Cervical Extension AROM
en.detail: Seated, extend to end range, hold, then use hand support behind head to progress further.

en.name: Prone Cervical Extension
en.detail: Lie face down. Slowly lift head and extend neck toward ceiling. Control return to floor.

en.name: Cervical Extension AROM
en.detail: Seated tall. Slowly tilt chin upward toward ceiling through full comfortable range. Return to neutral.

en.name: Progressive Cervical Flexion AROM
en.detail: Seated, flex cervical spine to end range, hold briefly, then attempt gentle overpressure with own hand.

en.name: Cervical Flexion with Chin Nod
en.detail: Seated, first tuck chin then flex entire cervical spine forward. Dissociates upper from lower cervical.

en.name: Cervical Flexion AROM
en.detail: Seated tall. Slowly drop chin toward chest through full comfortable range. Return to neutral.

en.name: Progressive Cervical Lateral Flexion
en.detail: Lateral flexion to end range. Gently assist with hand to move through any remaining restriction.

en.name: Side-Lying Cervical Lateral Flexion
en.detail: Lie on side without pillow. Slowly lift head toward ceiling (lateral flexion away from surface).

en.name: Cervical Lateral Flexion AROM
en.detail: Seated tall. Tilt ear toward shoulder to each side through full comfortable range. Stay relaxed.

en.name: Cervical Rotation with Retraction
en.detail: Seated, draw chin back into retraction. Rotate from this position left and right through full range.

en.name: Cervical Rotation AROM
en.detail: Seated tall. Rotate chin toward each shoulder through full comfortable range. Keep level.

en.name: Elbow Extension CARs
en.detail: Extend elbow to maximum range. At end range rotate forearm and attempt to gain further extension.

en.name: Elbow Extension with Load
en.detail: Overhead arm with light weight. Slowly extend elbow to full straight. Lower. Emphasize end range.

en.name: Active Elbow Extension AROM
en.detail: Seated, elbow bent. Slowly straighten elbow to full extension. Return. Emphasize end range.

en.name: Elbow Flexion CARs
en.detail: Flex elbow to maximum range. At end range rotate forearm and attempt to gain further flexion.

en.name: Elbow Flexion with Load
en.detail: Hold light weight. Slowly curl through full elbow flexion range. Lower fully. Emphasize end range.

en.name: Active Elbow Flexion AROM
en.detail: Seated, elbow at side. Slowly bend elbow to full flexion. Lower to full extension. Full range.

en.name: Finger Abduction CARs
en.detail: Abduct each finger individually in sequence from index to small finger. Control fully.

en.name: Progressive Finger Spreading
en.detail: Spread fingers wide. Then spread each individually as far as possible. Hold each.

en.name: Finger Abduction AROM
en.detail: Hand flat. Spread each finger apart from midline as wide as possible. Hold then adduct.

en.name: Finger Adduction CARs
en.detail: Adduct each finger individually toward midline in sequence from small finger to index.

en.name: Progressive Finger Squeeze
en.detail: Spread fingers wide. Adduct each adjacent pair together in sequence. Control movement.

en.name: Finger Adduction AROM
en.detail: Fingers spread wide. Bring all fingers together squeezing into adduction. Hold then spread.

en.name: Composite Finger Extension CARs
en.detail: From fist, extend digits sequentially through MCP, PIP, DIP. Arc through all joints smoothly.

en.name: Isolated MCP Extension
en.detail: Curl PIP and DIP joints. Extend only at MCP joints lifting knuckles. Full range.

en.name: Finger Extension AROM
en.detail: From full fist, slowly open hand spreading fingers into maximum extension. Repeat.

en.name: Composite Finger Flexion CARs
en.detail: Move fingers through composite flexion: MCP, PIP, DIP sequentially. Arc through all joints.

en.name: Isolated MCP Flexion
en.detail: Keep PIP and DIP straight. Bend only at MCP joints (knuckles). Full range then extend.

en.name: Finger Flexion AROM Full Fist
en.detail: Open hand fully spreading fingers. Slowly close into full fist through maximum range. Repeat.

en.name: Progressive Toe Abduction
en.detail: Standing barefoot. Abduct each toe individually away from midline. Work small toe to great toe.

en.name: Standing Toe Spreading
en.detail: Standing barefoot. Spread toes wide against floor. Hold maximum abduction then release.

en.name: Seated Toe Spreading AROM
en.detail: Seated barefoot. Spread all toes as wide as possible. Hold then relax together.

en.name: Progressive Toe Adduction
en.detail: Standing barefoot. Adduct each toe toward midline individually in sequence.

en.name: Standing Toe Adduction
en.detail: Standing barefoot. Squeeze toes together against floor resistance. Hold maximum adduction.

en.name: Seated Toe Adduction AROM
en.detail: Seated barefoot. Squeeze all toes together actively. Hold then spread apart.

en.name: Dynamic Toe Extension
en.detail: Standing barefoot. Lift toes in sequence from great toe outward. Control each individually.

en.name: Standing Toe Extension AROM
en.detail: Standing barefoot. Lift all toes off floor into extension keeping ball of foot down. Hold.

en.name: Seated Toe Extension AROM
en.detail: Seated barefoot. Lift all toes upward into extension. Hold briefly then lower fully.

en.name: Dynamic Toe Flexion
en.detail: Standing barefoot. Alternate curling and releasing toes in sequence from great toe to small toe.

en.name: Standing Toe Curl AROM
en.detail: Standing barefoot. Actively curl toes into flexion. Hold and release through full range.

en.name: Seated Toe Curl AROM
en.detail: Seated barefoot. Curl all toes downward into flexion. Hold briefly then straighten fully.

en.name: Hip Abduction CARs
en.detail: Standing, move hip through abduction, external rotation arc in controlled large motion.

en.name: Standing Hip Abduction AROM
en.detail: Standing on one leg. Lift opposite leg out to side through full range. Use wall for balance.

en.name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction AROM
en.detail: Lie on side, leg straight. Lift top leg as high as possible through abduction range. Lower slowly.

en.name: Hip Adduction CARs
en.detail: Standing, arc hip through adduction and internal rotation in controlled large motion.

en.name: Standing Hip Adduction AROM
en.detail: Standing on one leg. Sweep opposite leg across front of body into adduction. Use wall for balance.

en.name: Supine Hip Adduction AROM
en.detail: Lie on back, leg raised. Cross leg over midline into adduction. Return to neutral. Repeat.

en.name: 90-90 External Rotation
en.detail: Seated 90-90 position. Rotate torso toward back shin driving hip into external rotation.

en.name: Prone Hip External Rotation
en.detail: Lie face down, knee bent to 90 degrees. Let foot fall inward rotating hip outward. Control.

en.name: Seated Hip External Rotation AROM
en.detail: Seated, knee bent. Rotate foot inward moving hip into external rotation. Return and repeat.

en.name: Hip Extension CARs
en.detail: Standing, drive hip into extension and arc through full posterior range. Control throughout.

en.name: Standing Hip Extension AROM
en.detail: Standing on one leg. Swing opposite leg back into extension. Keep trunk upright.

en.name: Prone Hip Extension AROM
en.detail: Lie face down. Keeping knee bent, lift thigh off floor extending hip. Keep pelvis flat.

en.name: Hip Flexion CARs
en.detail: Standing on one leg. Drive opposite knee high, rotate hip, and lower through controlled arc.

en.name: Standing Hip March
en.detail: Standing tall. Alternate lifting knees high toward chest. Control each movement. Stay upright.

en.name: Supine Hip Flexion AROM
en.detail: Lie on back. Slowly draw one knee toward chest through hip flexion range. Lower and repeat.

en.name: 90-90 Internal Rotation
en.detail: Seated 90-90 position. Rotate torso toward front shin driving hip into internal rotation.

en.name: Prone Hip Internal Rotation
en.detail: Lie face down, knee bent to 90 degrees. Let foot fall out to side rotating hip inward. Control.

en.name: Seated Hip Internal Rotation AROM
en.detail: Seated, knee bent. Rotate foot outward moving hip into internal rotation. Return and repeat.

en.name: Single-Leg Tibial ER AROM
en.detail: Single-leg balance, knee slightly bent. Rotate tibia outward through full range. Control.

en.name: Standing Tibial External Rotation
en.detail: Standing, slightly flex knee. Rotate lower leg outward. Use wall for balance.

en.name: Seated Tibial External Rotation AROM
en.detail: Seated, knee at 90 degrees. Rotate foot and lower leg outward (tibial ER). Control return.

en.name: Terminal Knee Extension with Band
en.detail: Band behind knee. Stand on one leg. Complete last degrees of knee extension against band.

en.name: Standing Knee Extension AROM
en.detail: Lean on wall. Slowly straighten knee pressing heel into floor from 90 degrees to full extension.

en.name: Long Arc Quad AROM
en.detail: Seated at edge of chair. Slowly straighten knee to full extension. Hold briefly and lower.

en.name: Prone Knee Flexion AROM
en.detail: Lie face down. Bend knee bringing heel toward glute through maximum range. Control throughout.

en.name: Seated Knee Flexion AROM
en.detail: Seated at edge of chair. Slowly swing lower leg forward and back through maximum range.

en.name: Supine Heel Slide
en.detail: Lie on back, leg flat. Slowly slide heel toward glute bending knee. Slide back to straight.

en.name: Single-Leg Tibial IR AROM
en.detail: Single-leg balance, knee slightly bent. Rotate tibia inward through full range. Control.

en.name: Standing Tibial Internal Rotation
en.detail: Standing, slightly flex knee. Rotate lower leg inward (pigeon-toe). Use wall for balance.

en.name: Seated Tibial Internal Rotation AROM
en.detail: Seated, knee at 90 degrees. Rotate foot and lower leg inward (tibial IR). Control return.

en.name: Standing Lumbar Extension AROM
en.detail: Standing, hands on hips. Lean back through maximum lumbar extension range. Return slowly.

en.name: Cow Pose Extension
en.detail: Hands and knees. Drop belly toward floor (cow) arching lumbar spine into extension. Hold.

en.name: Prone Press-Up
en.detail: Lie face down, elbows under shoulders. Press up onto elbows arching low back. Keep hips on floor.

en.name: Standing Lumbar Flexion AROM
en.detail: Standing, hinge forward at hips. Move through maximum lumbar flexion range. Return slowly.

en.name: Cat Pose Flexion
en.detail: Hands and knees. Round lower spine upward (cat) pressing lumbar spine toward ceiling. Hold.

en.name: Supine Knees to Chest
en.detail: Lie on back. Draw both knees toward chest moving lumbar spine into full flexion. Hold briefly.

en.name: Standing Lumbar Lateral Flexion
en.detail: Standing, fix feet. Slide one hand down thigh into lateral flexion. Keep hips level.

en.name: Side-Lying Lumbar Lateral Flexion
en.detail: Lie on side, hips stacked. Lift torso sideways away from floor. Control return.

en.name: Seated Lateral Lumbar Bend
en.detail: Seated, hand on opposite knee. Lean trunk to side moving through lumbar lateral flexion range.

en.name: Standing Trunk Rotation
en.detail: Standing, arms crossed. Rotate trunk from side to side through full range at comfortable pace.

en.name: Seated Trunk Rotation AROM
en.detail: Seated tall. Rotate trunk to each side keeping pelvis still. Move through maximum range.

en.name: Supine Lumbar Rotation
en.detail: Lie on back, knees bent. Drop knees to each side slowly moving through lumbar rotation.

en.name: Scapular Depression CARs
en.detail: Depress scapulae fully then transition into protraction and retraction in combined arc.

en.name: Scapular Depression with Load
en.detail: Seated, hands on chair seat beside hips. Push through hands to depress and elevate body slightly.

en.name: Scapular Depression AROM
en.detail: Seated or standing. Push both shoulders downward away from ears through full range. Return slowly.

en.name: Dynamic Scapular Downward Rotation
en.detail: From full overhead, lower arm along scapular plane through complete downward rotation arc.

en.name: Scapular Depression and Retraction Combined
en.detail: From overhead position, pull arm down and back combining depression and retraction.

en.name: Scapular Downward Rotation AROM
en.detail: From arm overhead, slowly lower arm to side. Focus on scapular downward rotation movement.

en.name: Scapular Elevation CARs
en.detail: Elevate scapulae fully then transition to other positions in full scapular CARs sequence.

en.name: Scapular Elevation with Load
en.detail: Hold light weight in hands. Shrug shoulders toward ears through full range. Slow controlled return.

en.name: Scapular Elevation AROM
en.detail: Seated or standing. Shrug both shoulders toward ears slowly through full range. Lower slowly.

en.name: Serratus Punch AROM
en.detail: Lie on back, arm pointing toward ceiling. Punch arm further toward ceiling protracting scapula fully.

en.name: Wall Push-Up Protraction
en.detail: Hands on wall at chest height. At end of push-up, push further protracting scapulae. Return.

en.name: Scapular Protraction AROM
en.detail: Seated, arms at sides. Round shoulder forward protracting scapula fully. Return to retraction.

en.name: Prone Retraction AROM
en.detail: Lie face down, arms at sides. Squeeze shoulder blades together lifting arms slightly. Control.

en.name: Band-Resisted Retraction AROM
en.detail: Light band in hands. Pull shoulder blades back and together against resistance. Control forward.

en.name: Scapular Retraction AROM
en.detail: Seated or standing. Squeeze shoulder blades together protracting through full range. Return.

en.name: Progressive Shoulder Elevation AROM
en.detail: Raise arm overhead. At end range, add slight traction reaching further. Move through full upward rotation.

en.name: Arm Elevation Upward Rotation
en.detail: Standing. Raise arm in scapular plane to full overhead. Pause at 60, 90, and 120 degrees.

en.name: Scapular Upward Rotation AROM
en.detail: Standing. Slowly raise one arm forward to full overhead position. Focus on scapular rotation.

en.name: Shoulder Abduction CARs
en.detail: Abduct arm to maximum. Rotate arm in this position and move through rotational arc.

en.name: Assisted Shoulder Abduction AROM
en.detail: Use other hand or pulley to assist arm into abduction. Aim for full 180 degrees.

en.name: Shoulder Abduction AROM
en.detail: Standing. Raise arm out to side to comfortable end range. Lower slowly.

en.name: Shoulder Adduction CARs
en.detail: Sweep arm through full adduction arc from abduction to across midline in controlled motion.

en.name: Cross-Body Horizontal Adduction AROM
en.detail: Bring arm across chest. Apply gentle overpressure with opposite hand at end range. Return.

en.name: Shoulder Adduction AROM
en.detail: Standing. Cross arm across body into horizontal adduction. Return to neutral.

en.name: Sidelying Shoulder ER AROM
en.detail: Lie on side, elbow at 90. Let forearm drop toward floor into ER. Assist with other hand.

en.name: Shoulder ER AROM
en.detail: Elbow at 90 degrees at side. Rotate forearm outward away from stomach. Return to neutral.

en.name: Shoulder Extension CARs
en.detail: Move arm through maximum extension arc. At end range, attempt to reach further back.

en.name: Progressive Shoulder Extension AROM
en.detail: Prone lying. Lift arm from side into extension. Increase range each repetition.

en.name: Shoulder Extension AROM
en.detail: Standing. Swing arm back behind body into extension. Keep elbow straight. Return.

en.name: Shoulder Flexion CARs
en.detail: Raise arm to maximum flexion. At end range, attempt to reach further into new range.

en.name: Shoulder Pulley Assisted Flexion
en.detail: Pulley anchored above door. Use uninvolved arm to pull involved arm into flexion range.

en.name: Shoulder Flexion AROM
en.detail: Standing or seated. Raise arm forward to comfortable end range. Lower slowly.

en.name: Shoulder IR CARs
en.detail: Elbow at 90 degrees. Move forearm through maximum IR arc. At end range, increase range gently.

en.name: Sidelying Shoulder IR AROM
en.detail: Lie on back, elbow at 90 at side. Let forearm drop toward floor into IR. Assist if needed.

en.name: Shoulder IR AROM
en.detail: Elbow at 90 degrees at side. Rotate forearm inward toward stomach. Return to neutral.

en.name: Thoracic Extension CARs
en.detail: Seated, hands behind head. Isolate and extend thoracic spine only as far as possible without lumbar.

en.name: Foam Roller Thoracic Extension
en.detail: Foam roller perpendicular under mid-back. Support head. Extend over roller at each spinal level.

en.name: Seated Thoracic Extension
en.detail: Seated, hands behind head. Open elbows and gently extend thoracic spine backward.

en.name: Foam Roller Thoracic Flexion
en.detail: Foam roller lengthwise under spine. Flex thoracic spine to each side off roller for segmental motion.

en.name: Cat Pose
en.detail: Hands and knees. Round spine fully toward ceiling (cat) pressing mid-back up. Hold then release.

en.name: Seated Thoracic Flexion
en.detail: Seated, clasp hands together. Round upper back forward letting shoulder blades spread apart.

en.name: Standing Thoracic Side Bend
en.detail: Standing, fix pelvis. Reach one arm up and over bending only through thoracic spine not lumbar.

en.name: Side-Lying Thoracic Lateral Flexion
en.detail: Lie on side over foam roller at waist. Allow upper body to drop laterally opening thoracic side.

en.name: Seated Thoracic Side Bend
en.detail: Seated, raise one arm overhead. Lean to opposite side bending through thoracic spine.

en.name: Wrist Extension CARs
en.detail: Extend wrist to maximum. At end range, add finger extension and attempt to gain more range.

en.name: Wrist Extension with Load
en.detail: Forearm on table, hand off edge palm down. Lift wrist through full extension with light weight.

en.name: Wrist Extension AROM
en.detail: Elbow supported. Slowly extend wrist through full range. Return to neutral. Repeat.

en.name: Wrist Flexion CARs
en.detail: Flex wrist to maximum. At end range, add finger flexion and attempt to gain more range.

en.name: Wrist Flexion with Load
en.detail: Forearm on table, hand off edge. Slowly flex wrist through full range with light weight.

en.name: Wrist Flexion AROM
en.detail: Elbow supported. Slowly flex wrist through full range. Return to neutral. Repeat.

en.name: Pronation CARs
en.detail: Move through maximum pronation and combine with wrist ulnar deviation in arc. Full range.

en.name: Forearm Pronation with Load
en.detail: Hold hammer at mid-shaft. Rotate forearm palm down through full pronation. Return slowly.

en.name: Forearm Pronation AROM
en.detail: Elbow at 90 degrees. Slowly rotate forearm palm down through full pronation range. Return.

en.name: Radial Deviation CARs
en.detail: Move through maximum radial deviation. Arc into extension and return through neutral continuously.

en.name: Radial Deviation with Load
en.detail: Hold hammer vertically. Move wrist toward thumb side against hammer head weight. Full range.

en.name: Wrist Radial Deviation AROM
en.detail: Forearm supported, thumb up. Move wrist toward thumb side through full range. Return.

en.name: Supination CARs
en.detail: Move through maximum supination and combine with wrist radial deviation in arc. Full range.

en.name: Forearm Supination with Load
en.detail: Hold hammer at mid-shaft. Rotate forearm palm up through full supination. Return slowly.

en.name: Forearm Supination AROM
en.detail: Elbow at 90 degrees. Slowly rotate forearm palm up through full supination range. Return.

en.name: Ulnar Deviation CARs
en.detail: Move through maximum ulnar deviation. Arc into flexion and return through neutral continuously.

en.name: Ulnar Deviation with Load
en.detail: Hold hammer vertically. Move wrist toward small finger side against hammer weight. Full range.

en.name: Wrist Ulnar Deviation AROM
en.detail: Forearm supported, thumb up. Move wrist toward small finger side through full range. Return.

en.name: Single-Leg Heel Walk
en.detail: Balance on one heel with forefoot raised. Step forward on single heel. Maintain balance and control.

en.name: Heel Walk
en.detail: Stand and lift both forefeet off floor. Walk forward on heels only keeping toes raised.

en.name: Seated Ankle Dorsiflexion with Band
en.detail: Seated, band around foot anchored in front. Pull foot up and back against resistance. Control return.

en.name: Single-Leg Balance Eversion Challenge
en.detail: Single-leg balance on uneven surface. Focus on peroneal activation to maintain eversion control.

en.name: Standing Ankle Eversion
en.detail: Stand sideways near wall. Lift inner edge of foot turning sole outward. Hold and return.

en.name: Seated Ankle Eversion with Band
en.detail: Seated, band around outside of foot anchored inward. Push foot outward against resistance. Control return.

en.name: Short Foot Arch Hold
en.detail: Standing, pull ball of foot toward heel without curling toes doming the arch. Hold against resistance.

en.name: Standing Tibialis Posterior Activation
en.detail: Stand on one foot. Slightly supinate foot pressing inner arch upward. Hold and release. Repeat.

en.name: Seated Ankle Inversion with Band
en.detail: Seated, band around inside of foot anchored outward. Pull foot inward against resistance. Control return.

en.name: Resisted Cervical Extension with Band
en.detail: Loop band around forehead anchored to wall. Extend neck back against band resistance. Control return.

en.name: Seated Isometric Cervical Extension
en.detail: Seated, clasp hands behind head. Press head back into hands resisting all movement. Hold isometric contraction.

en.name: Resisted Cervical Flexion with Band
en.detail: Loop band around back of head anchored to wall. Flex neck forward against band resistance. Control return.

en.name: Seated Isometric Cervical Flexion
en.detail: Seated, press forehead firmly into palm. Resist all movement and hold the isometric contraction.

en.name: Supine Chin Tuck
en.detail: Lie on back. Gently tuck chin straight back and hold. Keep neck relaxed.

en.name: Side-Lying Cervical Rotation
en.detail: Lie on side. Rotate chin toward ceiling and hold. Return to neutral and repeat.

en.name: Resisted Lateral Cervical Flexion with Band
en.detail: Band around head anchored to side. Tilt head away against resistance through full range. Control return.

en.name: Side-Lying Head Lift
en.detail: Lie on side. Lift head off surface laterally keeping face forward. Hold and lower slowly.

en.name: Isometric Lateral Cervical Flexion
en.detail: Seated, place palm against temple. Press head into hand without moving. Hold isometric contraction.

en.name: Wall Push-Up
en.detail: Hands on wall at chest height. Bend elbows to lower chest toward wall then push back to start.

en.name: Progressive Single Finger Abduction
en.detail: Place hand on table. Abduct each finger individually away from midline. Hold then return.

en.name: Band Finger Abduction
en.detail: Wrap rubber band around finger pairs. Spread against resistance through full range. Control return.

en.name: Finger Spreading Unresisted
en.detail: Place hand flat on table. Spread all fingers as wide as possible. Hold then bring together.

en.name: Sequential Finger Adduction
en.detail: Spread all fingers wide. Bring each adjacent pair together in sequence, one at a time. Control fully.

en.name: Lateral Pinch Resistance
en.detail: Place each finger pair together. Apply manual resistance with opposite hand trying to spread them. Hold.

en.name: Paper Pinch Between Fingers
en.detail: Place thin paper between adjacent fingers. Squeeze fingers together to grip paper as it is pulled.

en.name: Sequential Finger Extension
en.detail: Curl into fist. Extend fingers one at a time from pinky to index. Then close one at a time in reverse.

en.name: Tabletop Finger Extension
en.detail: Place hand flat on table. Lift each finger up from table as high as possible. Hold each lift briefly.

en.name: Rubber Band Finger Extension
en.detail: Loop rubber band around all fingertips. Spread fingers apart against band resistance. Control return.

en.name: Fingertip Table Press
en.detail: Place fingertips on table. Press down firmly through fingertips resisting with opposite hand. Hold.

en.name: Hook Fist
en.detail: Curl fingers at first two joints keeping knuckles straight. This isolates FDS. Hold and release.

en.name: Ball Squeeze
en.detail: Hold soft ball or rolled towel. Squeeze all fingers firmly and hold. Release fully. Repeat.

en.name: Short Foot Exercise
en.detail: Standing barefoot. Pull ball of foot toward heel without curling toes to dome arch. Hold contraction.

en.name: Toe Spread and Squeeze
en.detail: Seated barefoot. Spread toes wide and hold, then squeeze together. Control each movement fully.

en.name: Towel Toe Curls
en.detail: Seated barefoot, towel on floor. Scrunch towel toward you using toes only. Repeat.

en.name: Single-Leg Squat with Lateral Band
en.detail: Band above knees. Single-leg squat keeping knee in alignment and resisting band collapse inward.

en.name: Standing Hip Abduction with Band
en.detail: Band above ankles, stand on one leg. Lift opposite leg out to side against resistance. Control return.

en.name: Side-Lying Hip Adduction
en.detail: Lie on side, top leg bent in front for balance. Lift bottom leg up toward ceiling. Hold and lower.

en.name: Supine Adductor Squeeze
en.detail: Lie on back, knees bent. Place pillow between knees. Squeeze pillow firmly and hold.

en.name: Resisted Hip Flexion March
en.detail: Band looped around both ankles. March in place driving knees up against resistance. Stay tall.

en.name: Standing Hip Flexion with Band
en.detail: Band around ankle anchored behind you. Standing, lift knee forward and up against resistance. Lower slowly.

en.name: Seated Hip Flexion March
en.detail: Seated tall at edge of chair. Alternate lifting knees toward chest against gravity. Keep trunk upright.

en.name: Wall Sit
en.detail: Back against wall, lower until knees are 90 degrees. Hold position with quads engaged.

en.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
en.detail: Kneel with feet anchored under couch. Lower body forward slowly by allowing knees to extend. Push back up.

en.name: Standing Hamstring Curl with Band
en.detail: Band around ankle anchored in front. Stand on one leg. Bend knee curling heel toward glute against resistance.

en.name: Prone Knee Bend
en.detail: Lie face down. Slowly bend one knee bringing heel toward glute. Lower under control. Keep thigh on floor.

en.name: Bird Dog with Pause
en.detail: Hands and knees. Extend opposite arm and leg, pause three seconds at top maintaining neutral spine.

en.name: Back Extension Hold
en.detail: Lie face down, hands behind head. Lift chest off floor using lumbar extensors. Hold at top.

en.name: Prone Press-Up
en.detail: Lie face down, hands under shoulders. Press up onto elbows lifting chest. Keep hips on floor.

en.name: Banded Woodchop
en.detail: Band anchored high. Pull diagonally down and across body rotating trunk. Control return slowly.

en.name: Supine Trunk Rotation Hold
en.detail: Lie on back, knees bent. Let knees drop to one side and hold using obliques to resist further movement.

en.name: Unilateral Dumbbell Shrug
en.detail: Hold household weight in one hand. Shrug that shoulder toward ear through full range. Lower slowly.

en.name: Bilateral Shoulder Shrug
en.detail: Standing. Shrug both shoulders toward ears fully. Hold and lower slowly with control.

en.name: Serratus Punch with Band
en.detail: Band anchored behind, arm forward at 90 degrees. Punch further forward protracting scapula. Control return.

en.name: Wall Push-Up Plus
en.detail: Hands on wall, slight bend in elbows. Push chest away from wall rounding upper back (serratus activation).

en.name: Scapular Retraction Isometric
en.detail: Seated tall. Squeeze shoulder blades together firmly. Keep shoulders away from ears. Hold.

en.name: Shoulder Abduction Isometric
en.detail: Stand arm's length from wall. Press back of wrist against wall lifting arm to 30 degrees. Hold.

en.name: Band Crossover Adduction
en.detail: Band anchored high to side. Pull arm diagonally across body and slightly downward. Control the return.

en.name: Band Shoulder Adduction
en.detail: Band anchored above at side. Pull arm down and across body keeping elbow straight. Control return.

en.name: Isometric Shoulder Adduction
en.detail: Stand with arm at side. Press upper arm against body firmly as if trying to crush something beneath arm. Hold.

en.name: External Rotation at 90 Degrees Abduction
en.detail: Arm out to side at 90 degrees. Rotate forearm up toward ceiling against band resistance.

en.name: Band External Rotation
en.detail: Elbow at 90 degrees at side, band in hand. Rotate forearm outward against resistance. Control return.

en.name: Isometric External Rotation
en.detail: Elbow at 90 degrees at side. Press back of wrist against door frame. Hold isometric contraction.

en.name: Band Shoulder Extension
en.detail: Band anchored in front at shoulder height. Pull arm back past hip keeping elbow straight. Control.

en.name: Shoulder Overhead Press
en.detail: Standing with light weight. Press arm from shoulder height to full overhead. Lower with control.

en.name: Band Shoulder Forward Raise
en.detail: Stand on band. Raise arm forward to 90 degrees with thumb up. Lower slowly.

en.name: Shoulder Assisted Pendulum
en.detail: Lean forward resting uninvolved arm on surface. Let involved arm swing forward and back in small arc.

en.name: Internal Rotation at 90 Degrees Abduction
en.detail: Arm out to side at 90 degrees. Rotate forearm down toward floor against band resistance.

en.name: Band Internal Rotation
en.detail: Elbow at 90 degrees at side, band in hand anchored to side. Rotate forearm inward. Control return.

en.name: Isometric Internal Rotation
en.detail: Elbow at 90 degrees at side. Press palm against door frame rotating inward. Hold isometric contraction.

en.name: Bird Dog
en.detail: Hands and knees. Extend opposite arm and leg simultaneously, bracing spine. Hold then alternate.

en.name: Superman Hold
en.detail: Lie face down, arms overhead. Simultaneously lift arms, chest, and legs. Hold at top then lower.

en.name: Prone Thoracic Press-Up
en.detail: Lie face down, arms at sides. Lift chest slightly off floor using thoracic extensors only. Hold briefly.

en.name: Eccentric Wrist Extension
en.detail: Use other hand to extend wrist. Remove assisting hand and lower slowly using extensors eccentrically.

en.name: Wrist Extension with Dumbbell
en.detail: Forearm on table, hand off edge palm down. Lift wrist up with light weight. Full range, slow return.

en.name: Reverse Wrist Curl
en.detail: Seated, forearm on thigh, hand over knee palm down. Lift wrist toward ceiling. Lower slowly.

en.name: Eccentric Wrist Flexion
en.detail: Use other hand to curl wrist up. Remove assisting hand and lower slowly using flexors eccentrically.

en.name: Wrist Flexion with Dumbbell
en.detail: Forearm on table, hand off edge palm up. Curl wrist up with light weight. Full range, slow return.

en.name: Wrist Curl
en.detail: Seated, forearm on thigh, hand over knee palm up. Curl wrist up toward ceiling. Lower slowly.

en.name: Pronation Against Band
en.detail: Band around palm anchored in supinated position. Rotate forearm to palm down against resistance.

en.name: Pronation with Hammer
en.detail: Hold hammer at mid-shaft, elbow at 90 degrees. Rotate forearm palm down against weight of hammer head.

en.name: Forearm Pronation Unresisted
en.detail: Elbow at 90 degrees. Slowly rotate forearm palm down through full range. Return to neutral.

en.name: Radial Deviation with Band
en.detail: Band around thumb side of hand anchored below. Deviate wrist toward thumb against resistance.

en.name: Radial Deviation with Hammer
en.detail: Hold hammer vertically at base, thumb up. Move wrist into radial deviation (thumb side up). Control.

en.name: Gravity-Assisted Radial Deviation
en.detail: Forearm on table thumb up, hand off edge. Allow wrist to drop (ulnar dev), then lift (radial dev).

en.name: Supination Against Band
en.detail: Band around palm anchored in pronated position. Rotate forearm to palm up against resistance.

en.name: Supination with Hammer
en.detail: Hold hammer at mid-shaft, elbow at 90 degrees. Rotate forearm palm up against weight of hammer head.

en.name: Forearm Supination Unresisted
en.detail: Elbow at 90 degrees. Slowly rotate forearm palm up through full range. Return to neutral.

en.name: Ulnar Deviation with Band
en.detail: Band around outside of hand anchored below. Deviate wrist toward small finger against resistance.

en.name: Ulnar Deviation with Hammer
en.detail: Hold hammer vertically at base, thumb up. Move wrist into ulnar deviation (small finger down). Control.

en.name: Gravity-Assisted Ulnar Deviation
en.detail: Forearm on table thumb up, hand off edge. Allow wrist to drop (radial dev), then lift (ulnar dev).

en.name: Prone Ankle Plantarflexion Stretch
en.detail: Lie face down, feet off bed edge. Allow gravity to pull foot into full plantarflexion range.

en.name: Kneeling Dorsiflexor Stretch
en.detail: Kneel sitting on heels with tops of feet flat. Gently shift weight backward pressing top of foot down.

en.name: Seated Ankle Plantarflexion Stretch
en.detail: Seated, loop towel under toes. Gently pull toes downward into plantarflexion. Hold.

en.name: Weight-Bearing Peroneal Stretch
en.detail: Stand on slight inward tilt (edge of mat). Allow foot to invert gently loading peroneal stretch.

en.name: Standing Peroneal Stretch
en.detail: Stand with foot turned inward (inversion). Hold onto surface for balance. Feel stretch on outer ankle.

en.name: Seated Ankle Inversion Stretch
en.detail: Seated, cross foot over opposite thigh. Gently turn sole inward stretching peroneal muscles.

en.name: Weight-Bearing Eversion Stretch
en.detail: Stand on slight outward tilt (edge of mat). Allow foot to evert gently loading invertor stretch.

en.name: Standing Tibialis Posterior Stretch
en.detail: Stand with foot turned outward (eversion). Hold surface for balance. Feel stretch along inner ankle.

en.name: Seated Ankle Eversion Stretch
en.detail: Seated, cross foot over thigh. Turn sole outward gently stretching tibialis posterior muscle.

en.name: Seated Gastroc Stretch
en.detail: Leg straight, loop towel around foot. Pull toes toward shin until stretch felt in calf.

en.name: Progressive Cervical Flexion Stretch
en.detail: Seated, drop chin to chest. Apply both hands to back of head and gently increase flexion range.

en.name: Suboccipital Release Stretch
en.detail: Lie on back with rolled towel at base of skull. Gently nod chin down to lengthen suboccipitals.

en.name: Supported Cervical Extension Stretch
en.detail: Lie on back over rolled towel at upper thoracic. Allow head to gently fall back into extension. Hold.

en.name: Prone Cervical Press-Up Stretch
en.detail: Lie face down, hands under shoulders. Press up onto elbows allowing neck to gently extend back.

en.name: Cervical Rotation Overpressure Stretch
en.detail: Rotate head to one side. Place hand on chin and apply gentle overpressure into further rotation.

en.name: Cervical Rotation with Lateral Flexion
en.detail: Rotate head to one side. Add slight lateral flexion toward same side to deepen cervical rotation stretch.

en.name: Scalene Stretch
en.detail: Tilt head to side. Rotate chin slightly upward toward ceiling to bias scalene muscles. Hold stretch.

en.name: Wall Tricep Stretch
en.detail: Place bent elbow on wall above head. Gently let body weight increase elbow flexion and tricep stretch.

en.name: Overhead Tricep Stretch
en.detail: Raise arm, bend elbow to reach down back. Use other hand to gently push elbow into further flexion.

en.name: Wall Bicep Stretch
en.detail: Place palm flat on wall behind at waist height. Step away rotating body until deep bicep stretch.

en.name: Progressive Finger Adduction Stretch
en.detail: Apply progressive pressure adducting fingers together. Work from radial to ulnar side sequentially.

en.name: Lateral Finger Overpressure
en.detail: Hold one finger and use other hand to press adjacent fingers toward it. Hold gentle adduction stretch.

en.name: Adjacent Finger Squeeze Stretch
en.detail: Place fingers together side by side. Squeeze gently and hold to stretch lateral finger structures.

en.name: Maximum Finger Spread Stretch
en.detail: Spread fingers maximally. Apply gentle traction at each web space and hold at maximum spread.

en.name: Progressive Finger Abduction Stretch
en.detail: Place fingers on table spread wide. Gently press fingers apart applying overpressure at web spaces.

en.name: Finger Web Space Stretch
en.detail: Use opposite hand to spread adjacent fingers apart. Work each web space individually.

en.name: Full Fist Overpressure Stretch
en.detail: Close to full fist. Use opposite hand to gently push fingers further into flexion. Hold.

en.name: Hook Fist Stretch
en.detail: Make hook fist curling PIP and DIP only. Apply gentle overpressure with opposite hand. Hold.

en.name: Passive Finger Flexion Stretch
en.detail: Use opposite hand to gently curl all fingers into flexion. Hold stretch through all joints.

en.name: Intrinsic Plus Stretch
en.detail: Hold MCP joints flat and flex PIP and DIP joints fully. Separates intrinsic from extrinsic stretch.

en.name: Table Extension Stretch
en.detail: Place palm flat on table. Gently press fingers flat extending joints. Apply body weight gradually.

en.name: Passive Finger Extension Stretch
en.detail: Use opposite hand to gently extend all fingers backward. Hold mild stretch through all joints.

en.name: Intrinsic Foot Stretch
en.detail: Seated, cross ankle over knee. Use hands to spread toe web spaces and stretch all intrinsic muscles.

en.name: Plantar Fascia Wall Stretch
en.detail: Stand with toes against wall at 45 degrees. Hold to load plantar fascia and intrinsic foot muscles.

en.name: Passive Toe Extension Stretch
en.detail: Seated, manually pull toes back into extension. Hold to stretch plantar fascia and toe flexors.

en.name: Seated Figure-4 Piriformis Stretch
en.detail: Seated, cross ankle over thigh. Lean trunk forward keeping back straight until gluteal stretch.

en.name: Cross-Leg Glute Stretch
en.detail: Seated in chair, cross ankle over opposite thigh. Gently press knee downward. Lean forward slightly.

en.name: Lateral Lunge Adductor Stretch
en.detail: Step wide to one side, lower into lunge keeping other leg straight. Feel stretch in straight-leg inner thigh.

en.name: Wide-Leg Seated Stretch
en.detail: Seated on floor, legs spread wide. Hinge forward at hips reaching hands between legs.

en.name: Supine Butterfly Stretch
en.detail: Lie on back, soles of feet together. Let knees fall out to sides. Gently press knees toward floor.

en.name: Standing Forward Fold
en.detail: Standing, hinge at hips letting hands reach toward floor. Keep back relatively straight.

en.name: Supine Figure-4 Stretch
en.detail: Lie on back. Cross ankle over opposite thigh forming figure-4. Pull thigh toward chest.

en.name: Pigeon Pose Hip Flexor Variant
en.detail: From plank, front shin forward toward opposite wrist. Lower hips to floor. Square hips forward.

en.name: Standing Hip Flexor Stretch
en.detail: Stand staggered. Shift weight forward stretching back hip flexor. Keep trunk tall.

en.name: Seated IT Band Stretch
en.detail: Seated on floor, cross bent knee over straight leg. Rotate trunk toward bent knee applying overpressure.

en.name: Cross-Leg IT Band Stretch
en.detail: Lie on back, cross one leg over other. Let both knees fall to opposite side until outer hip stretches.

en.name: Standing IT Band Stretch
en.detail: Cross one leg behind other. Lean sideways away from back leg. Feel stretch along outer thigh.

en.name: Prone Quad Stretch
en.detail: Lie face down. Bend knee and reach ankle with hand. Pull toward glute. Hold with hip neutral.

en.name: Side-Lying Quad Stretch
en.detail: Lie on side. Pull top ankle toward glute with hand. Keep hips stacked. Hold position.

en.name: Standing Quad Stretch
en.detail: Stand on one foot. Pull opposite ankle toward glute. Keep knees together. Hold.

en.name: Progressive Hamstring Stretch
en.detail: Supine, leg up. Apply gentle overpressure to heel to increase knee extension range.

en.name: Seated Forward Fold
en.detail: Seated on floor, legs straight. Hinge forward at hips reaching toward feet. Hold with relaxed back.

en.name: Prayer Stretch
en.detail: Kneel, sit hips back toward heels. Reach arms forward on floor stretching entire lumbar spine.

en.name: Knee to Chest Stretch
en.detail: Lie on back. Pull one or both knees to chest and hold to stretch lumbar extensors.

en.name: Upward-Facing Dog Stretch
en.detail: Lie face down, hands by chest. Press into full arm extension arching back. Thighs off floor.

en.name: Standing Lumbar Extension Stretch
en.detail: Standing, hands on lower back. Gently lean backward into lumbar extension. Hold and return.

en.name: Prone Cobra Stretch
en.detail: Lie face down, elbows under shoulders. Press up onto elbows arching low back. Keep hips on floor.

en.name: Progressive Trunk Rotation Stretch
en.detail: Seated rotation with hand behind head. Rotate and overpressure with elbow for increased range.

en.name: Seated Trunk Rotation Stretch
en.detail: Seated on floor, one leg straight. Cross other foot over, place elbow on bent knee. Rotate toward it.

en.name: Supine Lumbar Rotation Stretch
en.detail: Lie on back, knees bent. Drop both knees to one side keeping shoulders flat. Hold.

en.name: Combined Neck and Shoulder Depression Stretch
en.detail: Tilt ear toward shoulder. Actively depress opposite shoulder toward floor increasing stretch.

en.name: Prone Pec Stretch
en.detail: Lie face down, arm out to side at 90 degrees. Gently roll onto that side stretching chest.

en.name: Chest Opener Stretch
en.detail: Clasp hands behind head. Pull elbows back squeezing shoulder blades. Open chest toward ceiling.

en.name: Thoracic Flexion Stretch
en.detail: Seated, clasp hands behind head. Curl forward letting elbows drop toward thighs. Hold.

en.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
en.detail: Bring arm across chest. Hold above elbow with opposite hand and pull gently across body.

en.name: Seated Forward Reach Rhomboid Stretch
en.detail: Seated, clasp hands and reach arms forward rounding upper back. Let shoulder blades spread apart.

en.name: Posterior Capsule Stretch
en.detail: Lie on side of involved shoulder. Stabilize with body weight. Gently press forearm toward floor.

en.name: Cross-Body Stretch with Overpressure
en.detail: Arm across chest. Apply downward pressure at elbow increasing horizontal adduction range.

en.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
en.detail: Bring arm across chest. Use opposite hand to hold above elbow. Hold stretch in posterior shoulder.

en.name: Child's Pose Lateral Reach
en.detail: Kneel and sit hips back. Walk hands far to one side reaching to stretch shoulder adductors.

en.name: Doorway Lat Stretch
en.detail: Hold door frame at shoulder height. Step back allowing shoulder to reach into flexion and abduction.

en.name: Standing Side Stretch
en.detail: Raise one arm overhead and lean sideways. Feel stretch along side of trunk and shoulder.

en.name: Progressive Sleeper Stretch
en.detail: Sleeper stretch position. Gently increase overpressure with each breath. Move into new range.

en.name: Horizontal Internal Rotation Stretch
en.detail: Arm behind back. Gently reach opposite hand and pull wrist upward toward spine.

en.name: Doorway Overhead Shoulder Stretch
en.detail: Hold door frame overhead. Let body weight gently sink creating traction and stretch on posterior shoulder.

en.name: Overhead Tricep and Shoulder Stretch
en.detail: Raise arm and bend elbow overhead. Use other hand to pull elbow back. Feel stretch at shoulder.

en.name: Shoulder Wall Walk Stretch
en.detail: Stand facing wall. Walk fingers up wall reaching high. Hold at end range to stretch extensors.

en.name: Extended Arm Wall Stretch
en.detail: Arm behind at shoulder height against wall, palm forward. Rotate body away amplifying anterior stretch.

en.name: Doorway Anterior Shoulder Stretch
en.detail: Stand in doorway, arm along frame. Step through rotating body away from arm until stretch.

en.name: Standing Shoulder Extension Stretch
en.detail: Clasp hands behind back. Gently lift arms and roll shoulders back to stretch anterior shoulder.

en.name: Corner Pec Stretch
en.detail: Stand in corner, arms on each wall at 90 degrees. Lean into corner until deep anterior chest stretch.

en.name: Doorway Pec Minor Stretch
en.detail: Forearms on door frame, elbows at 90. Step through while keeping shoulders back and down.

en.name: Door Frame External Rotation Stretch
en.detail: Elbow at 90 degrees, press palm against door frame. Rotate body gently away until anterior stretch.

en.name: Foam Roller Thoracic Extension
en.detail: Foam roller perpendicular under mid-back. Support head. Extend over roller shifting to each level.

en.name: Thoracic Extension over Chair
en.detail: Sit in chair, arms crossed. Extend spine over chair back targeting mid-thoracic region.

en.name: Progressive Wrist Flexion Stretch
en.detail: Full wrist flexion stretch with overpressure and finger curl added. Hold deepest position.

en.name: Tabletop Wrist Flexion Stretch
en.detail: Place back of hand on table, fingers pointing away. Gently press down to increase wrist flexion.

en.name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
en.detail: Extend arm forward palm up. Use other hand to bend wrist back (extension) until forearm stretch.

en.name: Reverse Prayer Stretch
en.detail: Press backs of hands together, fingers pointing down. Lift hands toward chest. Hold.

en.name: Prayer Position Stretch
en.detail: Press palms together at chest. Lower hands toward waist keeping palms pressed. Wrist flexors stretch.

en.name: Wrist Extensor Stretch
en.detail: Extend arm, use other hand to gently flex wrist with fingers pointing down. Stretch on forearm top.

en.name: Progressive Supination Stretch with Wrist
en.detail: Combine full supination with wrist extension. Apply overpressure at both positions simultaneously.

en.name: Supported Supination Stretch
en.detail: Elbow supported on table. Apply gentle overpressure guiding forearm into maximum supination.

en.name: Passive Forearm Supination Stretch
en.detail: Elbow at 90 degrees. Use opposite hand to gently guide forearm into full supination. Hold.

en.name: Combined Wrist and Finger Ulnar Stretch
en.detail: Ulnar deviation with fingers extended. Apply gentle overpressure at end range.

en.name: Progressive Ulnar Deviation Stretch
en.detail: Forearm supported. Use opposite hand to guide wrist into maximum ulnar deviation. Hold.

en.name: Wrist Ulnar Deviation Stretch
en.detail: Hold wrist and gently push hand toward small finger side (ulnar deviation) to stretch radial deviators.

en.name: Progressive Pronation Stretch with Wrist
en.detail: Combine full pronation with wrist flexion. Apply overpressure at both positions simultaneously.

en.name: Supported Pronation Stretch
en.detail: Elbow supported on table. Apply gentle overpressure guiding forearm into maximum pronation.

en.name: Passive Forearm Pronation Stretch
en.detail: Elbow at 90 degrees. Use opposite hand to gently guide forearm into full pronation. Hold.

en.name: Combined Wrist and Finger Radial Stretch
en.detail: Radial deviation with fingers extended and splayed. Apply gentle overpressure at end range.

en.name: Progressive Radial Deviation Stretch
en.detail: Forearm supported. Use opposite hand to guide wrist into maximum radial deviation. Hold.

en.name: Wrist Radial Deviation Stretch
en.detail: Hold wrist and gently push hand toward thumb side (radial deviation) to stretch ulnar deviators.

en.name: Hip CARS
en.detail: Stand on one leg. Draw large controlled circles with opposite hip through full range.

en.name: Hip Hinge Practice
en.detail: Stand, feet hip-width. Hinge at hips keeping neutral spine, feel stretch in hamstrings.

en.name: Side-Lying Internal Rotation
en.detail: Side-lying on involved side, elbow at 90°. Rotate forearm upward against gravity. Focus on subscapularis activation. Lower slowly.

en.name: Internal Rotation with Band
en.detail: Elbow at side at 90°, band attached laterally. Rotate forearm inward toward belly keeping upper arm fixed. Return slowly to start.

en.name: Isometric Cervical Rotation
en.detail: Seated upright. Place hand on side of jaw. Attempt to rotate head into hand while hand resists all movement. Hold, then switch sides.

en.name: Isometric Wall Press
en.detail: Place palm flat against wall at shoulder height. Press gently and hold.

en.name: Knee to Chest
en.detail: Lying on back. Pull one knee to chest and hold. Keep opposite leg relaxed.

en.name: Knee to Wall
en.detail: Lunge stance, front foot close to wall. Drive knee forward over 4th toe, return.

en.name: Lateral Raise with Band
en.detail: Stand on band, arm at side. Raise arm out to the side to shoulder height, keeping slight elbow bend. Thumb slightly down (empty can). Lower with control.

en.name: Levator Scapulae Stretch
en.detail: Seated, hold chair with one hand. Rotate head 45° away, then tilt ear toward armpit. Feel deep stretch at base of skull behind shoulder. Light hand overpressure optional.

en.name: Mini Squat
en.detail: Feet shoulder-width. Squat to ~45° keeping knees over toes and weight through heels.

en.name: Neural Floss
en.detail: Seated upright, extend knee and dorsiflex ankle simultaneously. Add neck flexion for tension.

en.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
en.detail: Hold band overhead behind head, elbows pointing up. Extend elbows to straighten arms overhead. Keep upper arms fixed and lower with control.

en.name: Pallof Press
en.detail: Stand sideways to band anchor. Press band away from chest resisting trunk rotation.

en.name: Pelvic Tilt
en.detail: Lying on back, knees bent. Gently flatten lower back against floor and hold.

en.name: Pendulum
en.detail: Lean forward supporting torso. Let arm hang and draw small circles, gradually enlarging.

en.name: Pigeon Pose
en.detail: From kneeling, slide front shin forward and lower hips toward floor.

en.name: Plank with Arm Reach
en.detail: Hold plank position. Lift one arm forward while maintaining level hips.

en.name: Prone Cervical Extension
en.detail: Lying face down with forehead on a small folded towel. Gently lift head a small amount, keeping chin tucked. Hold briefly and lower.

en.name: Prone Head Lift
en.detail: Lying face down, forehead on towel. Lift head through full cervical extension range, keeping eyes on floor. Hold at top and slowly lower.

en.name: Prone Shoulder Extension
en.detail: Lying face down, arm at side. Keeping elbow straight, lift arm toward ceiling. Focus on posterior deltoid contraction. Lower slowly.

en.name: Prone Y-T-W
en.detail: Lying face down, raise arms to form Y, T, then W shapes. Focus on shoulder blade control.

en.name: Push-Up Plus
en.detail: Standard push-up starting position. At top, add protraction by spreading shoulder blades apart.

en.name: Resistance Band Row
en.detail: Hinge slightly forward. Pull band to hip squeezing shoulder blade back and down.

en.name: Resisted Cervical Extension
en.detail: Seated upright. Clasp both hands behind head. Press head backward into hands while hands resist. No movement — pure isometric contraction. Hold.

en.name: Resisted Cervical Flexion
en.detail: Seated upright. Place hand on forehead. Press forehead into hand (cervical flexion) and resist with hand. Equal force so no movement occurs. Hold.

en.name: Scapular Depression with Band
en.detail: Attach band overhead, hold with both hands. Pull shoulder blades down against band resistance, keeping arms straight. Focus on lower trapezius.

en.name: Seated Scapular Depression
en.detail: Sit upright with hands beside hips. Press palms lightly into chair and slide shoulder blades down away from ears. Hold briefly and release.

en.name: Seated Ankle Alphabet
en.detail: Seated, foot off floor. Trace the alphabet with your big toe, keeping leg still.

en.name: Seated Bicep Curl
en.detail: Seated, hold light band or weight with palm up. Keeping elbow at side, curl forearm toward shoulder. Lower slowly through full range.

en.name: Seated Calf Raise
en.detail: Seated with feet flat. Raise both heels and slowly lower.

en.name: Seated Piriformis Stretch
en.detail: Seated, cross foot over opposite knee. Sit tall and lean gently forward from hips.

en.name: Seated Thoracic Rotation
en.detail: Seated with arms crossed. Rotate trunk side to side through comfortable range.

en.name: Isometric Shoulder Abduction
en.detail: Stand with arm at side, press back of hand into hip or wall. Push outward without moving arm. Equal force — pure isometric contraction for deltoid activation.

en.name: Shoulder CARS
en.detail: Stand upright. Perform slow full shoulder circumduction keeping scapula controlled.

en.name: Shoulder Depression Stretch
en.detail: Seated, actively depress one shoulder downward while tilting head to opposite side. Hold the stretch along the top of shoulder. Release and repeat.

en.name: Shoulder Extension with Band
en.detail: Face band anchor at shoulder height. Pull arm straight back past hip, keeping elbow extended. Squeeze posterior shoulder at end range.

en.name: Isometric Shoulder Flexion
en.detail: Stand facing wall, arm at side. Place back of hand against wall. Press gently forward without moving arm. Hold, then relax.

en.name: Shoulder Flexion Overhead Stretch
en.detail: Seated or standing, reach both arms fully overhead. Clasp hands and reach as high as possible, lengthening through the shoulder joint. Hold at end range.

en.name: Shoulder Forward Raise with Band
en.detail: Stand on band, hold at thigh. Keeping elbow straight, raise arm forward to shoulder height. Lower slowly.

en.name: Overhead Press
en.detail: Stand with band under feet, handles at shoulder height. Press straight overhead through full shoulder flexion range. Control the descent.

en.name: Shoulder Pulley
en.detail: Use overhead pulley. Assist affected arm toward full elevation with uninvolved arm.

en.name: Shoulder Shrug
en.detail: Stand with arms at sides. Elevate both shoulders straight up toward ears, hold briefly, then slowly lower. Focus on upper trapezius.

en.name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
en.detail: Side-lying, top leg straight. Lift leg to ~30° keeping body in a straight line.

en.name: Single-Leg Balance on Foam
en.detail: Balance on one leg on foam or folded mat. Maintain full alignment for set duration.

en.name: Single-Leg Balance
en.detail: Balance on one leg with slight knee bend. Maintain without wobbling or hip drop.

en.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
en.detail: Stand on one foot at step edge. Lower heel fully and raise to toes with control.

en.name: Single-Leg Deadlift
en.detail: Stand on one leg. Hinge at hips reaching opposite hand toward floor, return.

en.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
en.detail: Glute bridge position, one leg extended. Lift hips using only the planted leg.

en.name: Single-Leg Hop and Hold
en.detail: Hop forward on one leg and stick the landing. Hold without wobbling for 2–3 seconds.

en.name: Single-Leg RDL (Wall Support)
en.detail: Fingertips on wall for balance. Balance on one leg and hinge forward slowly, return.

en.name: Single-Leg Squat to Chair
en.detail: Stand on one leg in front of chair. Slowly lower until barely touching chair, return.

en.name: Single-Leg Stance
en.detail: Stand on one leg with slight knee bend. Maintain steady posture without trunk sway.

en.name: Sleeper Stretch
en.detail: Side-lying on affected shoulder, elbow at 90°. Gently press forearm toward floor.

en.name: Soleus Stretch
en.detail: Same as gastroc but bend the back knee slightly to target the soleus.

en.name: Standing Bicep Curl
en.detail: Stand on band, palm up. Curl forearm to shoulder keeping upper arm fixed at side. Slowly lower and fully extend before next rep.

en.name: Standing Calf Raise
en.detail: Stand at step edge, heels hanging. Lower heels below step level then raise to toes.

en.name: Standing Gastroc Stretch
en.detail: Stand at wall, one foot back, heel flat. Lean forward until stretch felt in calf.

en.name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
en.detail: Heel on step, stand tall. Hinge forward from hips until stretch felt in back of thigh.

en.name: Standing Rectus Femoris Stretch
en.detail: Standing, hold ankle behind you. Pull heel toward glutes keeping knees together.

en.name: Sternocleidomastoid Stretch
en.detail: Seated, stabilize shoulder with opposite hand. Rotate head away and gently extend, feeling stretch along front-side of neck. Do not force range.

en.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
en.detail: Attach band overhead. Keeping elbow straight, pull arm down to hip in a wide arc. Resist on the return and control throughout.

en.name: Suboccipital Release
en.detail: Seated, interlace fingers behind head. Tuck chin and gently apply downward pressure to base of skull. Focus on the junction between skull and first vertebra.

en.name: Supine Cervical Head Lift
en.detail: Lying on back, perform chin tuck. Lift head 1–2 inches off surface keeping chin tucked. Hold briefly and lower with control.

en.name: Supine Chin Tuck and Nod
en.detail: Lying on back, perform a chin tuck. Then gently nod head by lifting only the base of skull off surface (not a full sit-up). Return slowly.

en.name: Supine Figure-4
en.detail: Lying on back, cross ankle over opposite knee. Gently pull thigh toward chest.

en.name: Supine Hamstring Stretch
en.detail: Lying on back. Hold behind thigh and gently straighten knee until stretch felt.

en.name: Supine Heel Slide
en.detail: Lying on back, brace core gently. Slide one heel along floor away and back.

en.name: Supine Hip Circles
en.detail: Lying on back. Draw slow, large circles with your knee exploring full hip range.

en.name: Terminal Knee Extension
en.detail: Tie band behind knee facing anchor point. Straighten knee against resistance, keeping hip neutral.

en.name: Thoracic CARS
en.detail: Seated upright. Perform slow controlled articular rotation of thoracic spine through full range.

en.name: Thread the Needle
en.detail: On all fours, slide one arm under body. Follow with gaze and allow rotation.

en.name: Tricep Kickback
en.detail: Hinge forward at hips with support. Hold band or weight, elbow at 90° at side. Straighten elbow behind you and slowly return.

en.name: Tricep Pushdown
en.detail: Attach band overhead. Hold handles, elbows at sides at 90°. Push handles straight down until elbows are fully extended. Return slowly — do not let elbows drift forward.

en.name: Tricep Stretch
en.detail: Raise arm overhead, bend elbow so hand reaches behind neck. Use other hand to gently push elbow further behind head. Feel stretch along back of upper arm.

en.name: Upper Trapezius Stretch
en.detail: Seated, stabilize one shoulder by holding edge of chair. Gently tilt ear toward opposite shoulder. Feel stretch along top of shoulder and side of neck.

en.name: Upright Row with Band
en.detail: Stand on band, hands close together. Pull band straight up along body to chin level, leading with elbows. Lower slowly.

en.name: VMO Quad Set
en.detail: Seated or lying, leg straight. Tighten quad focusing on inner muscle, hold then relax.
